# Professional Summary Writing

## Summary Formula

```
[Role] with [X] years of experience [specialization].
Proficient in [3-5 key skills matching job].
[Value proposition relevant to job].
```

## Constraints

- **Maximum**: 340 characters (STRICT)
- **Optimal**: 280-320 characters
- **Sentences**: 2-3 maximum
- **Focus**: Job-specific, never generic

## Structure

1. **First Sentence**: Role + experience + specialization
2. **Second Sentence**: Top skills (match job description)
3. **Third Sentence**: Value proposition (impact/contribution)

## Examples by Role

### Backend Developer
```
Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building scalable backend systems.
Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and microservices architecture.
Proven track record of delivering high-performance APIs serving millions of users.
```

### Full Stack Developer
```
Full Stack Developer with 2+ years creating end-to-end web applications.
Expert in React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and cloud deployment.
Delivered multiple production systems with focus on performance and user experience.
```

### AI/ML Focus
```
Software Engineer with 2+ years specializing in AI-powered applications.
Proficient in Python, LLMs, RAG, and full-stack development.
Built production systems integrating machine learning with modern web technologies.
```

## AVOID in Summaries

- ❌ Career objectives ("seeking", "looking for")
- ❌ Subjective claims ("hardworking", "dedicated", "passionate")
- ❌ Generic phrases ("team player", "problem solver")
- ❌ Personal pronouns ("I am", "my experience")
- ❌ Salary expectations
- ❌ References to this application

## DO in Summaries

- ✅ Match job title exactly
- ✅ Include required skills from job description
- ✅ Quantify experience years
- ✅ Mention specific technologies
- ✅ Highlight unique value
- ✅ Keep it concise and impactful
